news.headline: Maharashtra adds 4 more talukas to drought-hit list, total rises to 308 of 358
news.story_lead: Maharashtra adds 4 more talukas to drought-hit list, total rises to 308 of 358 The state government has also ordered a detailed survey of nine additional talukas to assess their drought conditions. On Tuesday, the Maharashtra government added four more talukas to its existing list of 304 drought-affected areas, bringing the total to 308 out of 358 talukas. The newly added talukas or tehsils are Chiplun, Wada and Vikramgad in Konkan – a region that received the highest rainfall this season -- along with Dindori in Nashik district.
news.full_article_text: Maharashtra adds 4 more talukas to drought-hit list, total rises to 308 of 358 The state government has also ordered a detailed survey of nine additional talukas to assess their drought conditions. On Tuesday, the Maharashtra government added four more talukas to its existing list of 304 drought-affected areas, bringing the total to 308 out of 358 talukas. The newly added talukas or tehsils are Chiplun, Wada and Vikramgad in Konkan – a region that received the highest rainfall this season -- along with Dindori in Nashik district. The state government has also ordered a detailed survey of nine additional talukas to assess their drought conditions. Revenue minister and chairman of the cabinet sub-committee on drought relief, Chandrashekhar Bawankule, declared this in a meeting on Tuesday afternoon. The four additions were made after elected representatives pressured the government underlining that farmers in these areas faced increased water scarcity and crop losses. While 13 proposals argued for the additions, the committee added the four talukas to the drought-hit list after a recent survey was completed. Also Read: PCMC eyes Pimpri defence land to grow fodder for drought-hit Marathwada, Vidarbha “We have approved four more talukas -- Chiplun, Dindori, Wada and Vikramgad – to the list. We have now ordered a survey of nine other talukas to be completed. A report is expected to be submitted in the next meeting,” said Bawankule. The nine under survey are: Hatkanangale, Kagal, Karveer and Gadhinglaj, from Kolhapur district, and Pen and Mahad from Raigad, among others. At the meeting, committee members also discussed the financial assistance of ₹ 4,701.6 crore distributed to 94.3 lakh farmers across the state. Of this, the Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar division received the highest allocation of ₹ 1,704.5 crore, followed by Nashik ( ₹ 1,001.2 crore), Pune ( ₹ 788 crore), Amravati ( ₹ 765.8 crore), Nagpur ( ₹ 406.2 crore) and Konkan ( ₹ 35.9 crore). Bawankule directed guardian secretaries of all districts to survey their respective areas before the upcoming winter session of assembly to assess the drought situation based on all prescribed parameters and submit detailed reports to chief secretary Rajesh Aggarwal. The minister added that the government will soon issue a Government Resolution (GR) outlining 10 measures to tackle the drinking water shortage and directed officials to carry out water conservation works across districts following the Shirpur pattern to improve groundwater levels. In this pattern, seasonal and perennial streams are deepened by 15–20 metres and widened by 20–30 metres to remove silt and expose subsurface layers, improving water storage. A series of check dams and weirs are constructed consecutively, following the ridge-to-valley approach. These structures slow down and retain surface runoff, preventing water from flowing quickly and maximising storage. Transport minister Pratap Sarnaik called attention to the severe shortage in Dharashiv, where only 5.34% of water stock remains. He called for a special meeting to plan water availability for the next eight to 10 months. District authorities have also been asked to promote maize and jowar cultivation under the VB-G RAM G scheme, to address fodder shortages. Orders have also been issued to undertake fodder cultivation along the banks of lakes. District collectors have been asked to utilise available District Planning Committee funds as per local requirements and work with voluntary organisations involved in addressing water scarcity. The meeting also discussed providing incentive assistance to farmers who regularly repay their loans. Officials informed the committee that the amount would be distributed after April 1, 2027. Following chief minister Devendra Fadnavis ’s orders, the existing ₹ 5,000 crore water conservation plan of the soil and water conservation department will be scrapped and a fresh plan prepared. The revised plan will prioritise drought-affected talukas, particularly in Vidarbha and Marathwada. A standard operating procedure for its implementation will be prepared within the next one to two months.

In an order dated November 6, Justice Vinod Kumar directed officials of the Indian High Commission in London and the Consulate General of India in New York to remain present at their respective locations during the witnesses’ virtual examination and designated the high court as the “court point” for conducting the cross examination. The court noted that their request was based on their advanced age, the inconvenience of undertaking international travel and the health risks posed by the air pollution conditions prevailing in the national capital during the proposed examination period. “In view of the permission granted for recording evidence through video conferencing, the alternative prayer seeking permission for physical appearance in India in February or March 2027 does not require separate consideration,” the court said. These circumstances constitute relevant considerations in determining the appropriate mode of recording their evidence”, the court added. The order was passed on an application filed by the two individuals, aged 77 and 79, in a pending petition under the Indian Succession Act seeking probate of a 2010 will. They submitted that their evidence was likely to be recorded between October 2026 and January 2027, a period when Delhi-NCR typically witnesses severe air pollution. They contended that prolonged exposure to such conditions could pose a health risk, particularly as they were not accustomed to Delhi’s climatic conditions during these months. Accordingly, they sought permission to depose through video conferencing. They expressed their willingness to travel to India and appear physically before the court in February or March 2027 Also Read: Not possible that gifts influenced woman to leave all her wealth to daughter: HC The petitioner opposed the application, arguing that allowing the request would further delay the proceedings. While allowing the application, the court directed the two individuals to pay a consolidated fee of ₹ 1 lakh towards the services of the IT officer, with the amount to be shared equally between them. The court further directed the local commissioner, the parties and the concerned coordinators to ensure strict compliance with the prescribed safeguards relating to witness identification, prevention of tutoring, production and exhibition of documents, administration of oath, recording of evidence, signing of transcripts and preservation of electronic records.

The Delhi high court has permitted two senior citizens residing in the US and the UK to record their evidence virtually in a probate case, considering their age, difficulties associated with international travel and health concerns arising from Delhi’s air pollution.

In an order dated November 6, Justice Vinod Kumar directed officials of the Indian High Commission in London and the Consulate General of India in New York to remain present at their respective locations during the witnesses’ virtual examination and designated the high court as the “court point” for conducting the cross examination.

The court noted that their request was based on their advanced age, the inconvenience of undertaking international travel and the health risks posed by the air pollution conditions prevailing in the national capital during the proposed examination period.

“In view of the permission granted for recording evidence through video conferencing, the alternative prayer seeking permission for physical appearance in India in February or March 2027 does not require separate consideration,” the court said.

news.headline: Rajnath Singh lands in Tokyo as India, Japan set out roadmap for defence and tech ties
news.story_lead: Rajnath Singh lands in Tokyo as India, Japan set out roadmap for defence and tech ties Rajnath Singh, with EAM Jaishankar, is in Tokyo for the 4th India-Japan 2+2 meeting, reviewing defence ties, maritime security and technology cooperation. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh arrived at the Ministry of Defence in Tokyo on Wednesday, where he was received by his Japanese counterpart, Shinjiro Koizumi. Upon his arrival at the Ministry, Singh was accorded a ceremonial guard of honour.
news.full_article_text: Rajnath Singh lands in Tokyo as India, Japan set out roadmap for defence and tech ties Rajnath Singh, with EAM Jaishankar, is in Tokyo for the 4th India-Japan 2+2 meeting, reviewing defence ties, maritime security and technology cooperation. Defence Minister Rajnath Singh arrived at the Ministry of Defence in Tokyo on Wednesday, where he was received by his Japanese counterpart, Shinjiro Koizumi. Upon his arrival at the Ministry, Singh was accorded a ceremonial guard of honour. The Defence Minister, alongside External Affairs Minister (EAM) S Jaishankar , reached the Japanese capital earlier on Wednesday to participate in the 4th India-Japan Foreign and Defence Ministers' Meeting (2 2). Upon landing, Singh was welcomed by India's Ambassador to Japan, Nagma Mallick , who also received EAM Jaishankar alongside Deputy Chief of Mission (DCM) Madhu Sudan . In a post on X, the Indian Embassy stated, "Hon’ble External Affairs Minister @DrSJaishankar has arrived in Tokyo to participate in the Fourth India-Japan Foreign and Defence Ministers’ Meeting (“2 2”) and hold the Nineteenth India-Japan Foreign Ministers’ Strategic Dialogue. Ambassador Mallick and DCM @Msudan welcome EAM in Tokyo on his arrival." Alongside his bilateral discussions with Koizumi, Singh and EAM Jaishankar will co-chair the 2 2 Ministerial Dialogue on the Indian side, alongside Koizumi and Japan's Minister for Foreign Affairs, Toshimitsu Motegi . Also Read: Rajnath, Jaishankar to meet Japanese counterparts tomorrow for 2+2 dialogue, deepen bilateral ties During the dialogue, the two countries will assess the entire range of their bilateral defence and strategic partnership, discuss regional and global issues, and reiterate their joint resolve towards a free, open, inclusive and rules-based Indo-Pacific, according to the Ministry of Defence (MoD). Singh's bilateral engagement with Koizumi marks the third meeting between the two defence ministers in 2026. Carrying forward the progress made during their previous interactions in New Delhi in August and on the margins of the ASEAN Defence Ministers' Meeting-Plus in Cebu in October, the two ministers will deliberate on boosting collaboration in defence technology and equipment, strengthening maritime security, expanding the scope and sophistication of tri-service joint exercises, and fostering closer industrial ties. Highlighting the broader objective of Singh's visit, the MoD said in a statement, "The upcoming visit aims to further deepen bilateral defence ties and chart the roadmap for enhanced operational and industrial synergy between the two countries." Earlier on Tuesday, ahead of his departure, Singh expressed anticipation about holding productive discussions during his visit to further cement the long-standing partnership. Also Read: India’s defence diplomacy at ADMM-Plus "India and Japan share a Special Strategic and Global Partnership rooted in mutual trust, democratic values, and a shared vision for a free, open, and rules-based Indo-Pacific," Singh posted on X. Sharing his plans for the visit, the Defence Minister said, “During this visit, we will review the steady progress in our defence and security cooperation and explore new avenues to deepen collaboration in technology, maritime security, and regional stability. I look forward to productive discussions that will further strengthen the enduring friendship between our two nations.”

On Tuesday, Arjuna met Union ports, shipping and waterways minister Sarbananda Sonowal, in Delhi and discussed funds for the projects. The restoration and dredging of the Buckingham Canal in Chennai at cost ₹ 2,700 crore was also discussed.

news.headline: PM Modi Gifts Traditional Indian Artworks and Cultural Crafts to Global Leaders at Manila ASEAN Summit
news.story_lead: During his two-day visit to Manila, Philippines, Prime Minister Narendra Modi presented a curated collection of traditional Indian handicrafts to international leaders attending the ASEAN, East Asia, and Quad meetings. The gifts highlighted India's regional heritage, including Kashmiri silk and Pashmina, Rajasthani Pichwai and Blue Pottery, Gujarat's Rogan and Agate crafts, and Karnataka's Bidriware.
news.full_article_text:
Prime Minister Narendra Modi concluded a two-day visit to Manila, Philippines, where he participated in the 23rd ASEAN-India Summit, the 21st East Asia Summit, and the Quad Leaders' Meeting. During the visit, he also attended the redevelopment ceremony of the historic Gurudwara Khalsa Diwan in Manila. To mark the occasion, PM Modi presented various world leaders with indigenous Indian handicrafts representing diverse art forms, textile traditions, and centuries-old artisan techniques from across the country.

Philippines President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. was presented with a hand-knotted Kashmiri silk carpet featuring intricate natural patterns of chinar leaves and floral elements. The President's spouse, First Lady Liza Araneta-Marcos, received a Kashmiri Pashmina shawl crafted from fine Changthangi goat cashmere, packed inside an intricate hand-painted paper-mache box.

US President Donald Trump received a Golden Pichwai painting originating from Nathdwara, Rajasthan, rendered with mineral colors and gold work on prepared cloth depicting lotuses, cows, and trees. Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi was gifted a Royal Blue Banarasi Katan Silk Stole enclosed in a Sadheli box, while Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese was presented with Jaipur's famous quartz-based blue pottery featuring hand-painted cobalt-blue designs.

Thailand's Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul was given a Rogan art painting, a centuries-old textile craft practiced by artisan families in Nirona village in Kutch, Gujarat, using boiled castor oil paint and a metal stylus. Vietnamese Prime Minister Le Minh Hung received a handcrafted leather wall hanging featuring embossed and perforated floral designs colored with natural vegetable dyes.

Cambodian Prime Minister Hun Manet received a 4,000-year-old lost-wax cast Dokra metal artwork showing a boat with people and birds. Timor-Leste Prime Minister Xanana Gusmao was gifted a semi-precious agate bowl from Khambhat, Gujarat—an art form awarded Geographical Indication (GI) status in 2017 as 'Agates of Cambay' and included in the One District One Product (ODOP) scheme for Anand district in 2023. Additionally, leaders from Myanmar and Brunei (Sultan Haji Hassanal Bolkiah) received GI-tagged Bidriware silver-inlay zinc-copper alloy vases from Bidar, Karnataka.

hindi_translation.headline: पीएम मोदी ने मनीला आसियान शिखर सम्मेलन में विश्व नेताओं को पारंपरिक भारतीय हस्तशिल्प और सांस्कृतिक कलाकृतियां उपहार में दीं
hindi_translation.story_lead: मनीला, फिलीपींस की दो दिवसीय यात्रा के दौरान, प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने आसियान, पूर्वी एशिया और क्वाड बैठकों में भाग लेने आए वैश्विक नेताओं को भारत की समृद्ध क्षेत्रीय कला को प्रदर्शित करने वाले पारंपरिक हस्तशिल्प उपहार में दिए। इन उपहारों में कश्मीरी रेशम और पश्मीना, राजस्थान की पिछवाई और ब्लू पॉटरी, गुजरात की रोगन व अकीक कला और कर्नाटक का जीआई-टैग वाला बिदरीवेयर शामिल थे।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
प्रधानमंत्री नरेंद्र मोदी ने मनीला, फिलीपींस की अपनी दो दिवसीय यात्रा पूरी की, जहां उन्होंने 23वें आसियान-भारत शिखर सम्मेलन, 21वें पूर्वी एशिया शिखर सम्मेलन और क्वाड नेताओं की बैठक में भाग लिया। यात्रा के दौरान उन्होंने मनीला स्थित ऐतिहासिक गुरुद्वारा खालसा दीवान के पुनर्विकास समारोह में भी शिरकत की। इस अवसर पर पीएम मोदी ने विभिन्न वैश्विक नेताओं को भारत की विविध कला पद्धतियों, वस्त्र परंपराओं और सदियों पुरानी शिल्प कौशल का प्रतिनिधित्व करने वाले पारंपरिक हस्तशिल्प भेंट किए।

फिलीपींस के राष्ट्रपति फर्डिनेंड आर. मार्कोस जूनियर को हाथ से बुना हुआ कश्मीरी सिल्क कालीन भेंट किया गया, जिसमें चिनार के पत्तों और फूलों की जटिल डिजाइन बनी हुई है। राष्ट्रपति की पत्नी, प्रथम महिला लिज़ा अरानेटा-मार्कोस को चांगथांगी बकरी के बारीक कैशमीयर ऊन से बनी कश्मीरी पश्मीना शॉल दी गई, जो हाथ से चित्रित पेपर-मैशी बॉक्स में रखी गई थी।

अमेरिकी राष्ट्रपति डोनाल्ड ट्रंप को नाथद्वारा, राजस्थान की प्रसिद्ध गोल्डन पिछवाई पेंटिंग भेंट की गई, जिसे कपड़े पर प्राकृतिक रंगों और सोने के काम से सजाया गया है। जापान की प्रधानमंत्री सनाए ताकाइची को साधेली बॉक्स में रखी रॉयल ब्लू बनारसी कातान सिल्क स्टोल भेंट की गई, जबकि ऑस्ट्रेलियाई प्रधानमंत्री एंथनी अल्बनीज को जयपुर की प्रसिद्ध क्वार्ट्ज आधारित ब्लू पॉटरी कलाकृति दी गई।

थाईलैंड के प्रधानमंत्री अनुतिन चार्नविराकुल को गुजरात के कच्छ जिले के निरौना गांव की सदियों पुरानी रोगन कला पेंटिंग दी गई, जिसे उबले हुए अरंडी के तेल के रंग और धातु की स्टाइलस की मदद से बनाया जाता है। वियतनामी प्रधानमंत्री ले मिन्ह हंग को हस्तनिर्मित लेदर वॉल हैंगिंग भेंट की गई।

कंबोडिया के प्रधानमंत्री हुन मानेट को 4,000 साल पुरानी लॉस्ट-वैक्स कास्टिंग तकनीक से बनी ढोकरा कलाकृति दी गई, जिसमें नाव में बैठे लोग और पक्षी दर्शाए गए हैं। तिमोर-लेस्ते के प्रधानमंत्री शनाना गुसमाओ को खंभात, गुजरात का अकीक (एगेट) कटोरा दिया गया—इस कला को 2017 में 'एगेट्स ऑफ कैम्बे' के नाम से जीआई टैग मिला था और 2023 में आनंद जिले के ओडीओपी में शामिल किया गया था। इसके अलावा, म्यांमार के नेता और ब्रुनेई के सुल्तान को बिदर, कर्नाटक का जीआई-टैग वाला बिदरीवेयर सिल्वर-इनले फूलदान दिया गया।

news.story_lead: Assam tribunal declares 5 family members Indians; categorises 6th ‘Streamline Foreigner’ There is a distinction in the citizenship framework applicable to people who entered Assam from the erstwhile East Pakistan A Foreigners Tribunal (FT) in Assam’s Silchar has declared five members of a family Indian citizens, but the sixth a “Streamline Foreigner” after fresh adjudication. The “Streamline Foreigner” classification deprives Mohanlal Das, 75, of voting rights for 10 years based on a distinction in the framework applicable to people who entered Assam from the erstwhile East Pakistan (Bangladesh) before March 25, 1971. On November 6, the tribunal declared Das’s late wife, Pramila, and their four children, Pushpabala, Sumanbala, Sudhan and Madhu, all residents of Saidpur village in Cachar, Indian citizens 20 years after proceedings against the family began in 2006.
news.full_article_text: Assam tribunal declares 5 family members Indians; categorises 6th ‘Streamline Foreigner’ There is a distinction in the citizenship framework applicable to people who entered Assam from the erstwhile East Pakistan A Foreigners Tribunal (FT) in Assam’s Silchar has declared five members of a family Indian citizens, but the sixth a “Streamline Foreigner” after fresh adjudication. The “Streamline Foreigner” classification deprives Mohanlal Das, 75, of voting rights for 10 years based on a distinction in the framework applicable to people who entered Assam from the erstwhile East Pakistan (Bangladesh) before March 25, 1971. On November 6, the tribunal declared Das’s late wife, Pramila, and their four children, Pushpabala, Sumanbala, Sudhan and Madhu, all residents of Saidpur village in Cachar, Indian citizens 20 years after proceedings against the family began in 2006. Advocate Dharmananda Deb, who represented the family during the fresh proceedings, said the tribunal began hearing the cases in 2017, and all six family members were declared foreigners in May 2022. The family submitted photocopies of documents, but the tribunal did not accept them. The tribunal’s fresh opinion noted that the family failed to prove the documents during cross-examination. Deb said the family moved the Gauhati High Court, challenging the tribunal’s 2022 decision. The court in September directed the tribunal to reconsider. Deb said the family submitted at least 16 documents, including electoral records and land ownership documents, supporting their claim that they and their family had been living in India for decades. The tribunal’s finding about Das rested on its assessment of his date of entry into India. He claimed that he arrived from East Pakistan in September 1964, and received a certificate from the rehabilitation ministry in February 1966. Das produced a 1967 registered deed, showing the purchase of land, and electoral records in which his name appeared from 1970 onwards. The tribunal held that the certified copy of his certificate had not been duly proved because the relevant records were not summoned from the issuing authority. It noted that his name appeared in electoral rolls from 1970 and accepted the 1967 land deed as a document that could be presumed genuine. The tribunal found that these records did not establish his claimed arrival in 1964. It inferred that he had entered India after 1966 but before 1970 and tagged him a “Streamline Foreigner”. Given his age, the restriction would have a significant impact on him, Deb said. Das’s brother-in-law, Dilip, supported the case of Pramila. He produced a 1966 electoral roll carrying the name of their father along with his voter ID and other relevant documents. The tribunal found Dilip’s evidence credible and concluded that their father had entered India before 1966. It accepted Pramila’s claim to Indian citizenship. Their four children were consequently also held to be Indian citizens. People who entered India before January 1, 1966, are covered for citizenship under Section 6A of the Citizenship Act, which was incorporated following the Assam Accord. Those who entered between January 1, 1966, and March 24, 1971, fall under a separate category. After being detected as foreigners, they have to register. Their names are removed from electoral rolls for 10 years. They are deemed citizens after the prescribed period, subject to the statutory conditions. The latest tribunal opinion came amid a backlog of cases and continuing efforts to identify and expel declared foreigners in Assam. According to a report presented in the Assam assembly in March 2025, 4,36,046 cases were referred to foreigners tribunals in the state as of January that year. Of these, 3,48,014 cases were disposed of. The tribunals declared 1,65,992 people foreigners and 1,32,015 Indians citizens. As many as 85,162 cases remained pending. Chief minister Himanta Biswa Sarma told the assembly in July that 1,72,673 undocumented immigrants were identified under the Assam Accord framework. He said 73,750 cases were pending before tribunals and 31,789 people were deported, pushed, sent back, or expelled since 1985. The Gauhati High Court on November 10 expressed concern over the number of declared foreign nationals yet to be apprehended and expelled. It referred to a state government affidavit and noted that 1,16,946 declared foreigners across 36 districts remained to be apprehended and expelled as of June 30.

news.headline: Caltech Robot Accomplishes First Autonomous Structural Assembly in Space Without Astronauts
news.story_lead: A robot developed by the California Institute of Technology (Caltech) has successfully assembled part of a space structure in orbit without human intervention. Launched in March, the robotic system connected individual struts and joints to build a section of an experimental antenna, marking a major advancement in autonomous orbital construction.
news.full_article_text:
### Milestone in Autonomous Space Assembly
A robotic system designed by researchers at the California Institute of Technology (Caltech) has achieved a breakthrough in space engineering by assembling structural components in orbit without astronaut assistance.

### Mechanism and Operations
The robot, which was launched into space in March, carried out the autonomous assembly process by joining individual struts and joints to construct a new section of an experimental antenna. This represents the first time that a complex structural segment has been put together in space completely independent of human spacewalkers or on-site manual controls.

### Potential Impact on Space Infrastructure
Autonomous robotic construction overcomes traditional payload volume limitations imposed by rocket fairings. By assembling large-scale equipment like high-gain communication antennas, space observatories, and orbital facilities directly in space, future missions can bypass the structural and size constraints of launching pre-assembled hardware from Earth.

### स्वायत्त अंतरिक्ष निर्माण में ऐतिहासिक उपलब्धि
कैलिफोर्निया इंस्टीट्यूट ऑफ टेक्नोलॉजी (कैल्टेक) के शोधकर्ताओं द्वारा डिजाइन किए गए एक रोबोटिक सिस्टम ने बिना किसी अंतरिक्ष यात्री की सहायता के कक्षा में ढांचागत घटकों को जोड़कर अंतरिक्ष इंजीनियरिंग में एक नया मील का पत्थर स्थापित किया है।

### असेंबली प्रक्रिया और कार्यप्रणाली
मार्च में कक्षा में स्थापित किए गए इस रोबोट ने व्यक्तिगत स्ट्रट्स और जोड़ों को आपस में जोड़कर एक प्रायोगिक एंटीना के एक नए हिस्से का निर्माण किया। यह पहली बार है जब अंतरिक्ष में बिना किसी मानव सहायता के इस तरह के जटिल ढांचे की असेंबली पूरी की गई है।

### भविष्य के अंतरिक्ष अभियानों पर प्रभाव
कक्षा में स्वायत्त रोबोटिक निर्माण तकनीक रॉकेट के पेलोड आकार की सीमाओं को समाप्त करती है। अंतरिक्ष में सीधे बड़े संचार एंटीना, ऑब्जर्वेटरी और अन्य बड़े ढांचों का निर्माण करके भविष्य के अभियानों को अधिक प्रभावी बनाया जा सकता है।

news.full_article_text:
### Supreme Court Initiates Criminal Contempt Action Against Advocate

The Supreme Court of India has issued a formal notice in a criminal contempt petition against advocate Pravin Singhal for making alleged defamatory and objectionable remarks against Chief Justice of India (CJI) Surya Kant during open court proceedings.

Key factual details regarding the case include:
* **Bench Composition:** A three-judge bench comprising Justice Dipankar Datta, Justice Joymalya Bagchi, and Justice V. Mohana heard the petition and recorded its prima facie satisfaction that the contemnor's actions scandalised the court.
* **Procedures and Statutory Consent:** The contempt petition was instituted by the Supreme Court Bar Association (SCBA) after obtaining prior statutory consent from Attorney General (AG) R. Venkataramani under Section 15(1)(b) of the Contempt of Courts Act, 1971.
* **Timeline and Directions:** The apex court directed Pravin Singhal to file his response by January 8, requiring his personal presence during the next hearing scheduled for January 20.
* **Triggering Incident:** The controversy arose during court proceedings when Singhal requested immediate listing of a case filed on November 2, for which he had received no response for 15 days. Upon being informed by the CJI that the matter would be examined, Singhal raised his voice, made objectionable comments, and was subsequently removed from the courtroom by security personnel.
* **Legal Submissions:** SCBA President Pradeep Kumar Rai and Secretary Pragya Baghel raised the matter, supported by Solicitor General Tushar Mehta appearing virtually to assist the court.
* **Scope of Petition:** The SCBA also raised broader concerns regarding unauthorized courtroom video filming circulated on social media. The bench permitted the SCBA to amend its petition regarding social media platforms while maintaining current focus on the respondent advocate.

hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### वकील के खिलाफ सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने शुरू की आपराधिक अवमानना कार्रवाई

भारत के उच्चतम न्यायालय ने खुली अदालत की सुनवाई के दौरान भारत के मुख्य न्यायाधीश (CJI) सूर्य कांत के खिलाफ कथित अपमानजनक और आपत्तिजनक टिप्पणियां करने के लिए वकील प्रवीन सिंघल के खिलाफ आपराधिक अवमानना याचिका पर औपचारिक नोटिस जारी किया है।

मामले से जुड़े प्रमुख तथ्य इस प्रकार हैं:
* **पीठ का गठन:** न्यायमूर्ति दीपांकर दत्ता, न्यायमूर्ति जॉयमाल्या बागची और न्यायमूर्ति वी मोहना की तीन सदस्यीय पीठ ने याचिका पर सुनवाई की और प्रथम दृष्ट्या माना कि अवमाननाकर्ता के कृत्य ने अदालत की गरिमा को ठेस पहुंचाई है।
* **प्रक्रिया और वैधानिक सहमति:** सुप्रीम कोर्ट बार एसोसिएशन (SCBA) ने अदालत की अवमानना अधिनियम, 1971 की धारा 15(1)(b) के तहत अटॉर्नी जनरल आर वेंकटरमणी से औपचारिक सहमति प्राप्त करने के बाद यह अवमानना याचिका दायर की।
* **समयसीमा और निर्देश:** शीर्ष अदालत ने प्रवीन सिंघल को 8 जनवरी तक अपना जवाब दाखिल करने का निर्देश दिया और 20 जनवरी को होने वाली अगली सुनवाई के दौरान व्यक्तिगत रूप से उपस्थित रहने का आदेश दिया।
* **घटना का कारण:** यह विवाद तब शुरू हुआ जब वकील सिंघल ने 2 नवंबर को दायर एक मामले की तत्काल सुनवाई का अनुरोध किया, जिस पर 15 दिनों से कोई प्रतिक्रिया नहीं मिली थी। जब मुख्य न्यायाधीश ने कहा कि वे मामले को देखेंगे, तो सिंघल ने अपनी आवाज उठाई, आपत्तिजनक टिप्पणियां कीं और उन्हें सुरक्षाकर्मियों द्वारा अदालत कक्ष से बाहर निकालना पड़ा।
* **कानूनी प्रस्तुतियां:** SCBA के अध्यक्ष प्रदीप कुमार राय और सचिव प्रज्ञा बघेल ने इस मामले को उठाया, जिसका अदालत में सॉलिसिटर जनरल तुषार मेहता ने भी समर्थन किया।
* **याचिका का दायरा:** SCBA ने सोशल मीडिया पर कोर्ट रूम की अनधिकृत वीडियो रिकॉर्डिंग से जुड़ी चिंताएं भी उठाईं। पीठ ने SCBA को सोशल मीडिया प्लेटफॉर्म्स को शामिल करने के लिए याचिका में संशोधन करने की अनुमति दी, जबकि वर्तमान में नोटिस केवल वकील तक सीमित रखा गया है।

news.headline: Supreme Court Refuses to Stay Interim Bail Granted to Azam Khan in PMLA Case
news.story_lead: The Supreme Court of India has refused to stay an Allahabad High Court order granting interim bail to senior Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan in a money laundering case. A bench led by Chief Justice of India Surya Kant directed the Enforcement Directorate to present its arguments during the scheduled hearing, declining to interfere with his release.
news.full_article_text:
### Supreme Court Hearing on Interim Relief
The Supreme Court of India declined an urgent request from the Enforcement Directorate (ED) seeking a stay on the interim bail granted to 78-year-old Samajwadi Party leader Azam Khan. A bench comprising Chief Justice of India Surya Kant and Justice Joymalya Bagchi refused to issue a status quo order against Khan's release. The court directed Solicitor General SV Raju, representing the ED, to submit the agency's objections during the regular hearing scheduled before the bench.

### High Court Observations on Procedural Safeguards
The ED's challenge arises from an order issued by a division bench of the Allahabad High Court, consisting of Justice Rajiv Gupta and Justice Devendra Singh. The High Court granted interim bail after identifying prima facie non-compliance by the ED with the mandatory provisions of Section 19 of the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA) and fundamental guarantees under Article 22(1) of the Constitution.

The High Court scrutinised the timing of Khan's arrest on October 31, which took place outside Rampur district jail immediately after he obtained bail in a separate forgery case. The High Court observed that the sequence of events indicated a motivated and mala fide exercise. Furthermore, the High Court emphasized that the ED failed to submit documentary evidence—such as videography or photographic proof—to back its claim that Khan refused to accept written grounds of arrest before being produced for remand.

### Case Allegations and Related Proceedings
The money laundering investigation concerns alleged financial irregularities linked to the Maulana Mohammad Ali Jauhar Trust, founded and managed by Khan. Allegations include the illegal diversion of government funds and irregularities surrounding the acquisition of land and construction of the Mohammad Ali Jauhar University, where Khan holds the position of honorary chancellor.

The Allahabad High Court has fixed December 10 for the next hearing in the main petition. In a parallel development, the Supreme Court also dismissed a petition filed by the Uttar Pradesh government challenging the Allahabad High Court's stay on Khan's conviction in a fake birth certificate case.

hindi_translation.headline: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने मनी लॉन्ड्रिंग मामले में आजम खान की अंतरिम जमानत पर रोक लगाने से किया इनकार
hindi_translation.story_lead: उच्चतम न्यायालय ने धन शोधन निवारण अधिनियम (PMLA) मामले में वरिष्ठ समाजवादी पार्टी नेता आजम खान को इलाहाबाद उच्च न्यायालय द्वारा दी गई अंतरिम जमानत पर रोक लगाने से इनकार कर दिया है। मुख्य न्यायाधीश सूर्या कांत की अध्यक्षता वाली पीठ ने प्रवर्तन निदेशालय को अपनी आपत्तियां नियमित सुनवाई के दौरान प्रस्तुत करने का निर्देश दिया।
hindi_translation.full_article_text:
### अंतरिम राहत पर उच्चतम न्यायालय का निर्णय
भारत के उच्चतम न्यायालय ने 78 वर्षीय समाजवादी पार्टी नेता आजम खान की अंतरिम जमानत रोकने संबंधी प्रवर्तन निदेशालय (ED) की त्वरित याचिका को खारिज कर दिया। मुख्य न्यायाधीश सूर्या कांत और न्यायमूर्ति जॉयमाल्या बागची की पीठ ने खान की रिहाई पर यथास्थिति का आदेश देने से इनकार कर दिया। अदालत ने ईडी का प्रतिनिधित्व कर रहे सॉलिसिटर जनरल एसवी राजू को नियमित सुनवाई के दौरान अपनी आपत्तियां पेश करने का निर्देश दिया।

### प्रक्रियात्मक सुरक्षा उपायों पर उच्च न्यायालय की टिप्पणियां
ईडी की यह चुनौती इलाहाबाद उच्च न्यायालय की खंडपीठ (न्यायमूर्ति राजीव गुप्ता और न्यायमूर्ति देवेंद्र सिंह) के आदेश के खिलाफ आई थी। उच्च न्यायालय ने पीएमएलए की धारा 19 के तहत वैधानिक सुरक्षा उपायों और संविधान के अनुच्छेद 22(1) के तहत मौलिक अधिकारों का प्रथम दृष्टया पालन न होने पर अंतरिम जमानत दी थी।

उच्च न्यायालय ने 31 अक्टूबर को रामपुर जिला जेल के बाहर खान की गिरफ्तारी के समय पर सवाल उठाया, जो एक अन्य जालसाजी मामले में जमानत मिलने के तुरंत बाद हुई थी। अदालत ने इसे दुराशयपूर्ण अभ्यास करार दिया। इसके अलावा, अदालत ने पाया कि ईडी ने इस दावे को साबित करने के लिए वीडियो या फोटो जैसा कोई लिखित साक्ष्य प्रस्तुत नहीं किया कि खान ने लिखित गिरफ्तारी आधार स्वीकार करने से इनकार किया था।

### मामले के आरोप और संबंधित घटनाक्रम
मनी लॉन्ड्रिंग जांच मौलाना मोहम्मद अली जौहर ट्रस्ट में कथित वित्तीय अनियमितताओं से संबंधित है, जिसके संस्थापक आजम खान हैं। इसमें सरकारी धन के गबन और मोहम्मद अली जौहर विश्वविद्यालय के निर्माण में भूमि अधिग्रहण की अनियमितताओं के आरोप शामिल हैं। उच्च न्यायालय ने मुख्य याचिका की अगली सुनवाई 10 दिसंबर तय की है। इसके अतिरिक्त, उच्चतम न्यायालय ने फर्जी जन्म प्रमाण पत्र मामले में खान की सजा पर उच्च न्यायालय की रोक को चुनौती देने वाली उत्तर प्रदेश सरकार की याचिका भी खारिज कर दी।

From maritime security to trusted supply chains, new technologies and disaster response, our endeavour is to ensure that the Quad delivers trusted solutions to the entire Indo-Pacific,” Modi said in his opening remarks at the meeting. Modi announced Mumbai will host the inaugural Quad Business Leaders Forum in early 2027, while Trump said the grouping will conduct its first military exercise with maritime patrol aircraft to “protect peace through strength”. “As four major market economies, we have a shared responsibility to create greater trade opportunities and build stronger supply chains. To turn our strategic cooperation into commercial partnerships, India has announced the Quad Business Leaders Forum,” Modi said. The forum will gather business leaders, government officials and policy experts to foster greater business ties across private sectors, including the promotion of commercial deals and partnerships, a joint press release said. “If Australia's mining experience, Japan's recycling technology, America's expertise and India's manufacturing base come together, they could provide new strength to supply chains,” Modi added. The Indo-Pacific Maritime Surveillance Collaboration, which takes forward the Quad’s earlier maritime domain awareness initiative, is meant to enhance information-sharing and maritime awareness. The P-8 and P-3 maritime patrol aircraft of the four countries will join “a maritime exercise for the first time in a Quad context, making our seas safer”, the release said. This exercise will be conducted on the sidelines of Exercise Sea Dragon in Guam in March 2027 to address shared challenges such as illegal fishing and trafficking, foreign secretary Vikram Misri said. The four leaders also announced an expansion of the Quad Partnership for Cable Connectivity and Resilience, currently focused on the safety of telecommunications cables. “This will now expand to undersea energy cables as well,” Misri said, referring to Australia’s contribution focused on electricity cables to strengthen regional energy security. The four countries also welcomed upcoming undersea cable projects in the Indian Ocean intended to strengthen regional connectivity. The Quad acknowledged a “rapid increase in the number and scale of cyber incidents” in the region and announced enhanced cybersecurity cooperation between the four countries to “achieve an open and secure cyberspace”. The Quad nations said in the joint press release that the grouping is a “force for good and a partnership of action, committed to peace, stability, and prosperity”, while strongly opposing “any destabilising or unilateral actions that seek to change the status quo, including by force or coercion, which escalate tensions and undermine regional peace and stability”. This was an apparent reference to China's assertive actions in the South China Sea, where it is engaged in territorial disputes with several Asean states. The Quad expressed “grave concerns about economic coercion, including through arbitrary export restrictions” – again, an apparent reference to China's restrictions on the export of crucial commodities such as rare earths and fertilisers. The Quad nations said they are securing critical supply chains, protecting freedom of navigation and overflight, driving growth through future technologies, including investments in trusted Artificial Intelligence (AI), and responding to disasters with life-saving assistance. “We commit to work together to ensure open, safe, and resilient maritime transit corridors in the Indo-Pacific,” the press release added. Modi noted that the Quad's maritime domain awareness partnership has already created a real-time data sharing mechanism that is used to address illegal fishing and illicit activities in the Indo-Pacific, and said the grouping should aim to promote peace and prosperity, economic and technological resilience, and delivery of public goods. “Safeguarding maritime security begins with ensuring the safety of the seafarers who keep it moving,” Modi said. “Therefore, we must work together to establish a robust international framework for the safety of seafarers. Local Palestinians said there was an attack by settlers in part of al-Duyuk al-Tahta, near Jericho, which is meant to be under the full control of the Palestinian Authority. According to the Israeli army, there was a Palestinian car-ramming attack on an Israeli vehicle. It said rocks were then thrown at the Israelis, who opened fire in response. It did not mention the fatal shooting of a woman. There have been high tensions in the area since a group of settlers recently set up a new outpost. They moved into eight houses in the village on 4 November after buying them, they have said, in a secretive operation. The properties are in an area where Israel retains full security control. All settlements are illegal under international law. - UK sanctions firms over Israeli West Bank settlements Published 2 hours ago Local Palestinians said that the events in al-Duyuk al-Tahta on Monday night began with harassment by Israeli settlers. Palestinian children threw stones, they said, and the settlers opened fire, killing Fadda al-Fahidat, who was 72, outside her home. Fadda's daughter-in-law, Nema al-Fahidat, told the BBC that she died from a single bullet wound to the head. "It destroyed her brain," she said. According to the Palestinian accounts, Fadda's son, Arafat, rushed to the scene in his car after hearing the news and collided with an empty Israeli settler car parked outside his family home, injuring settlers who were standing nearby. The settlers then fired more shots, they said, injuring several Palestinians, including Arafat. "My husband, when he saw his mother, was not paying attention. He crashed into the vehicle. The vehicle was empty," Nema said. "My husband got out of his car and tried to reach his mother and the injured young men. Then he was shot." She added: "We tried to gather the injured people and move them away from the settler. We brought them here. But he kept firing, firing, firing. Even after we had brought the wounded young men here and moved them away from him, he continued shooting." Nema said young Palestinians threw stones at the settlers after seeing what happened, but asked: "What can stones do against bullets?" Medics say Palestinians and Israelis were wounded in the incident on Monday The statement from the Israel Defense Forces (IDF) said that "terrorists accelerated their vehicle toward an Israeli vehicle and rammed it", and then "exited their vehicle with weapons and attacked and harmed the occupants of the Israeli vehicle". Afterwards, it said, "rocks were hurled at the Israelis, who responded by firing in order to remove the threat." Later, an Israeli military source said Fadda was shot by an Israeli civilian and that there was no evidence that she had been involved in the confrontation near her home. Meanwhile, a spokesperson for Israel's police force said it had opened an investigation, and that officers and forensic technicians had been collecting evidence and interviewing witnesses. The Israeli human rights group B'Tselem says there has been a prolonged campaign of settler attacks, intimidation and land seizures in al-Duyuk al-Tahta, with Israeli troops now stationed nearby to secure the new settlement. Residents and activists say armed settlers walk and drive quad bikes around the neighbourhood as they threaten Palestinian residents. A BBC team saw settlers at the end of the street where Fadda was shot on Tuesday, as well as Israeli flags flying from four of the houses that they had moved into earlier this month. A group of settlers set up a new outpost in al-Duyuk al-Tahta earlier this month (file photo) In a separate incident on Monday evening, eight Palestinians were injured when they were hit by a vehicle driven by an Israeli settler on a main road in Tuqu, south of Bethlehem, according to Palestinian officials and the Palestinian Red Crescent. The IDF said the incident was a traffic accident. But the Palestinian foreign ministry called it a "terrorist attack", saying the driver hit a group of Palestinians who had gathered near the scene of an earlier traffic accident. Also on Monday, the Civil Administration - the body that implements Israeli government policy in the West Bank - announced the allocation of more than 28 sq km (6,945 acres) of land in the northern Jordan Valley to nine settlers for grazing, according to the Israeli anti-settlement watchdog Peace Now. It said handing over vast tracts of land to settlers for grazing outposts constituted "direct support for the systematic expulsion of Palestinians from their lands and the rampant criminal violence in the West Bank". The UK government announced on Tuesday that it was imposing sanctions on eight companies building Israeli settlements in the West Bank. It is the first sanctions package since Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband's pledge in September to respond to the accelerating rate of settlement expansion in the West Bank, which he said risked rendering a two-state solution unviable. Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Saar called the sanctions a "hostile act targeting private, law-abiding companies". news.story_lead: The BRICS Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) Framework Programme has completed 10 years of operation. The multilateral initiative serves as a core mechanism for joint scientific research, technology exchange, and innovation projects among BRICS member states.
news.full_article_text:
### 10th Anniversary of BRICS STI Framework Programme

The BRICS Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) Framework Programme has reached a major milestone, commemorating its 10th anniversary. Established to facilitate joint research and innovation projects, the programme provides a structured platform for scientific collaboration across member countries.

* **Milestone Achieved:** Completion of a decade of structured multilateral cooperation under the BRICS STI framework.
* **Objective:** Fostering joint research proposals, facilitating technology transfer, and promoting scientific exchange among participating nations.
* **Role in South-South Cooperation:** Serves as a key pillar for developing collective research capabilities and addressing common technological challenges across emerging economies.
bullet_points: The BRICS Science, Technology and Innovation (STI) Framework Programme marked its 10th anniversary.
The programme acts as a primary vehicle for joint research and development projects among BRICS member states.
It facilitates collaboration in advanced scientific domains, innovation ecosystems, and multilateral research calls.
The 10-year milestone highlights ongoing efforts to strengthen scientific cooperation among emerging economies.
key_facts: The BRICS STI Framework Programme has completed 10 years of operation.
The framework enables joint scientific projects and collaborative technological development among member states.
important_dates: November 17, 2026: Marking of the 10th anniversary of the BRICS STI Framework Programme.

Mains: Multilateral scientific diplomacy, South-South technology cooperation, and the role of international scientific frameworks in capacity building.

Joint research initiatives under such frameworks help pool resources, address common developmental challenges, and reduce technological dependencies.
impacts: Fosters joint scientific research and technology transfer among BRICS partner countries.
way_forward: Expand joint call mechanisms and focus on emerging technological domains such as artificial intelligence, renewable energy, and biotechnology.

ब्रिक्स विज्ञान, प्रौद्योगिकी और नवाचार (STI) फ्रेमवर्क कार्यक्रम ने एक महत्वपूर्ण मील का पत्थर हासिल करते हुए अपनी 10वीं वर्षगांठ मनाई है। संयुक्त अनुसंधान और नवाचार परियोजनाओं को सुविधाजनक बनाने के लिए स्थापित यह कार्यक्रम सदस्य देशों के बीच वैज्ञानिक सहयोग के लिए एक संरचित मंच प्रदान करता है।

* **उपलब्धि:** ब्रिक्स एसटीआई ढांचे के तहत संरचित बहुपक्षीय सहयोग के एक दशक का समापन।
* **उद्देश्य:** संयुक्त अनुसंधान प्रस्तावों को बढ़ावा देना, प्रौद्योगिकी हस्तांतरण को सुगम बनाना और प्रतिभागी राष्ट्रों के बीच वैज्ञानिक आदान-प्रदान को बढ़ावा देना।
* **दक्षिण-दक्षिण सहयोग में भूमिका:** उभरती अर्थव्यवस्थाओं में सामूहिक अनुसंधान क्षमताओं को विकसित करने और साझा तकनीकी चुनौतियों से निपटने के लिए एक प्रमुख स्तंभ के रूप में कार्य करता है।
